table.name: TLGNR_MAP_SAP_UOM_BS
table.description: Mapping of SAP UoM codes into LOGON codes. The mapping table is used only in incoming interfaces of SAP.

column.name: MAP_SAP_UOM_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the reference data used by incoming SAP interfaces.

column.name: UOM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_bs. Unit of measure as known and distinguished by Logon.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
